item.title: 1991 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1991 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce has been registered in California since new, and it was acquired by the seller in 2011. It is finished in Alfa Red over beige leather and suede and is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission. The car is further equipped with a black soft top, 15" 12-hole alloy wheels, air conditioning, power windows, and a Pioneer CD stereo. item.title: 42k-Mile 2004 Toyota Tacoma SR5 PreRunner Xtracab TRD V6 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2004 Toyota Tacoma PreRunner SR5 Xtracab has accrued 42k miles with one registered owner in New Jersey. Equipment includes the TRD Off-Road package, 16" alloy wheels, chrome bumpers, a hood deflector, a bedliner, a sliding rear window, tubular side steps, air conditioning, and a CD/cassette stereo. item.title: LS3-Powered 1964 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu Sport Coupe
item.description: This 1964 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu sport coupe was acquired by the current owner in 2015 and underwent a refurbishment in 2022, during which it was fitted with a 6.2-liter LS3 crate V8 and a 4L80 four-speed automatic. item.title: 1957 Porsche 356A Coupe Rally Car
item.description: This 1957 Porsche 356A coupe was modified for rally use in the 1990s by Tuthill Porsche in England and was subsequently driven by Mary Ellen Kane in La Carrera Panamericana rallies from 1990 to 1993. She continued to pilot the car to victory in the 2000 Rally du Maroc Classic and the classic car division of the 2002 London to Athens World Cup Rally before it was retired from competition use in the mid-2000s. item.description: This 2022 Ferrari F8 Spider was purchased new by the owner and was ordered with approximately $122k in options, some of which include carbon-fiber exterior and interior accents in addition to an Extra Range Blu Elettrico finish. The carbon-fiber racing seats are trimmed in Nero leather and Alcantara, and the car is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V8 paired with a seven-speed dual-clutch automated transaxle.
